title: King: 11th Malaysia Plan to focus on flood mitigation  | The Star
text:
King: 11th Malaysia Plan to focus on flood mitigation | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The 11th Malaysia Plan will give due focus to issues concerning flood mitigation and post-flood rehabilitation, said Yang di-Pertuan Agong Tuanku Abdul Halim Mu'adzam Shah in his royal address at the third session of the 13th parliament sitting, Monday.
In addressing the unprecedented floods which hit several states towards the end of 2014, the King urged the Government, state governments and all affected parties to work together in post-flood recovery processes.
